title: Blogsify
description: A full-stack blogging platform built with React for a dynamic frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Users can create, read, update, and delete blog posts, stored in a database (e.g., MongoDB). Includes features like user authentication, comments, and a responsive design with Tailwind CSS..

title: TrentShopNow / E-Commerce Platform
description: A fully responsive e-commerce website built with React, Node.js, and MongoDB. Features user authentication, product filtering, and a secure payment gateway.

title: Portfolio Website
description: A full-stack showcase built with React for a vibrant, responsive frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Highlights personal projects, skills, and contact details, with data stored in a database. Designed with Tailwind CSS for a polished, professional look. Includes smooth animations and a dark theme.

title: VideoX
description: A full-stack video streaming app built with React for a responsive frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Enables users to watch and browse videos, stored in a database (e.g., MongoDB) or cloud storage. Features a modern UI with Tailwind CSS and video playback integration.

title: GymWala
description: A full-stack video streaming app built with React for a responsive frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Enables users to watch and browse videos, stored in a database (e.g., MongoDB) or cloud storage. Features a modern UI with Tailwind CSS and video playback integration.

title: Netflix Clone
description: A full-stack app mimicking Netflix, built with React for a dynamic, responsive UI and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Features movie streaming, browsing, and user profiles, with data stored in a database (e.g., MongoDB). Integrates external APIs for content and uses CSS for styling..

title: IMDB
description: This is a full-stack web application inspired by IMDb, designed to manage and display movie information. The frontend, built with React, provides a responsive and interactive user interface for browsing movies, viewing details, and searching through a catalog. Features include dynamic routing, state management (e.g., with Redux or Context API), and a sleek design using modern CSS frameworks like Tailwind CSS.

title: Live TV
description: A full-stack application built with React for a dynamic frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Streams live TV channels using embedded video players or third-party APIs, with a channel list and basic controls. Data is managed in a database (e.g., MongoDB), styled with Tailwind CSS for a sleek, responsive UI.

title: Task Management App
description: A simple full-stack app built with React for an interactive UI and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Allows users to create, edit, and delete tasks, with data persisted in a database (e.g., MongoDB). Features a clean design using Tailwind CSS and basic CRUD functionality.

title: Image Gallary
description: A full-stack app built with React for an interactive frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Displays a collection of images with features like upload, view, and delete, stored in a database (e.g., MongoDB) or cloud storage. Styled with Tailwind CSS for a responsive, grid-based layout.

title: Logic Website
description: An interactive 3D product visualizer built with Three.js, allowing users to rotate and customize products in real-time.

title: Logic Builder Website
description: A full-stack personal portfolio built with React for a modern, responsive frontend and Node.js with Express for the backend API. Showcases projects, skills, and contact info, with data managed in a database (e.g., MongoDB). Features a clean, professional design using Tailwind CSS.
